Southampton County, Virginia Tax Sales: Your Easy Guide to Buying Property at Auction

Southampton County, Virginia holds tax sales to collect unpaid property taxes. These public auctions give you a chance to buy real estate at a lower price while helping the county recover lost revenue. If you’re thinking about joining, here’s a clear and simple guide to get you started.

How Tax Sales Work in Southampton County

Southampton County doesn’t set tax sales on a regular calendar. They schedule sales only when there are enough properties with unpaid taxes.

  • Auction Type: Non-judicial public tax auctions
  • Reason for Sale: To recover delinquent real estate taxes
  • Schedule: Sales happen as needed, not annually
  • Where to Find Dates: Check the auction calendar or the county website

Tax Sale Details – Everything You Need to Know

Here’s what to expect during the auction process from registration to payment.

  • Auction Format: Most tax sales are held online
  • Auction Time: Times vary—check the auction listing for exact details (typically Eastern Time)
  • Registration:
    • You must register before bidding
    • Instructions are in the auction notice or available by contacting the Treasurer’s Office
  • Redemption Period:
    • The owner has until the day of the sale to pay all taxes, fees, and penalties
    • Once the property is sold, it can’t be redeemed
  • How Bidding Works:
    1. Highest bidder wins
    2. Deposit required—amount varies by sale
    3. Accepted payment methods: personal check, money order, cashier’s check (no cash)
    4. Final balance is due within the timeframe listed in the auction terms

Where to Find Auction Updates

Stay informed by visiting these pages:

  • Southampton County Auction Information Page – Find schedules, listings, and requirements
  • Auction Calendar – Track upcoming sales and deadlines

Who to Contact for Help

If you have questions or need assistance with a sale:

  • Southampton County Treasurer’s Office
  • Phone: (757) 653-3015
  • Email: cedwards@southamptoncounty.org or csmith@southamptoncounty.org
  • Mailing Address: P.O. Box 400, Courtland, VA 23837

Smart Tips for Auction Success

Make your experience smoother by keeping these tips in mind:

  • Rural homes may have working outbuildings—verify the condition before factoring it into value.
  • Ask the county if there’s been a prior failed auction—it could change your approach.
  • Check if any lots include timber rights; it could influence your long-term strategy.
